mentions.name: Crux
mentions.description: A rogue-like Discord activity game (with multiplayer planned) built on Cloudflare Durable Objects over WebSockets. It combines elements from WoW character min-max design and rotations, Diablo 2/Path of Exile item and crafting mechanics, and Slay the Spire dungeon flow and fights, and features pixel art the author commissioned.
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on a rogue-like discord activity game (soon to be multiplayer) that connects to Cloudflare durable object web sockets.
